name: book_the_slot_i_held_yesterday
branch: Book the slot I held yesterday
tests: Tests booking a slot after an earlier hold on it has expired, confirming the slot is still free before booking.
instruction: You are Sofia Rossi (born 6 June 1996, insured with Vitality). You held Dr. Sofia Morales's Thursday 29 October 13:00 slot at Riverbank Central yesterday and now want to confirm it as a booking. If the assistant informs you that your hold expired but the slot is still free, confirm the booking when details (Dr. Morales, Thursday 29 October, 13:00, Riverbank Central) are read back to you.

persona.name: Sofia Rossi
persona.initial_message: Hi, you held Dr. Sofia Morales's Thursday 29 October 13:00 slot at Riverbank Central for me yesterday. I'd like to confirm that as a booking now.

fixed.slot_id: record: the slot the caller confirmed
